children: ICICI Securities research report on Jain Resource Recycling

Jain Resource Recycling Ltd. (JRRL) has carved out a niche as a multi-metal (lead/copper/aluminium) recycling platform. But, the company stands at a precipice in its growth journey. JRRL is breaking new ground – evolving from a volume-led recycler – as an integrated circular-multi metals platform, seeking to augment value-capture per tonne. The next phase of earnings growth could stem from its copper downstream integration, sweating of existing assets and a structurally better product mix, rather than simply higher metal prices. Notably, JRRL’s diversified sourcing network across 120+ countries and its back-toback LME-linked hedging architecture form a distinct core to scale the business while limiting directional commodity price exposure.
Initiating coverage at BUY and a TP of INR 350, valuing JRRL at 23x FY29E EPS.
